ValidationRule.description: Code suffix must equal the initials of the first two name words, serial must not mirror the year, the epoch year must equal the code year, and approved codes must end in a letter.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Code__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Epoch_Seconds__c)), REGEX(Code__c, 'PRJ-[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{4}-[A-Z]{2}'), OR( RIGHT(Code__c, 2) <> (UPPER(LEFT(Name, 1)) & UPPER(MID(Name, FIND(' ', Name) + 1, 1))), MID(Code__c, 10, 4) = REVERSE(MID(Code__c, 5, 4)), YEAR(DATEVALUE(FROMUNIXTIME(Epoch_Seconds__c))) <> VALUE(MID(Code__c, 5, 4)), MID(Code__c, 14, 1) <> CHR(45), AND(Is_Approved__c, ASCII(RIGHT(Code__c, 1)) < 65) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Project code failed the forensic cross-check against name, epoch and approval state.
